entry.title: the case for structure before style
entry.content:
I keep coming back to structure before style, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

Structure before style shows up across writing work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: notes on structure before style
entry.content:
A quick write-up on structure before style, mostly so future me stops relearning it.

why it matters

Structure before style shows up across writing work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: structure before style, revisited
entry.content:
Short post: structure before style is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Structure before style shows up across writing work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
